applicability: Checking passive hinge geometry, axis sign, period, and damping controls before actuation experiments

claim: In the exact certified L2.0 collisionless fixed-base single-link fixture at 120 Hz, the live passive hinge reproduces the analytic physical-pendulum period within the declared tolerance, retains the declared geometry and sign conventions, preserves the undamped control behavior, and shows the expected energy and amplitude reduction only when damping is enabled.

evidence.certification_claim_boundary: This campaign can certify only the exact L2.0-L2.7 joint-actuator observations named by the source-pinned programs. Fixed scaffolds, free roots, actuator envelopes, hard-limit reactions, two-joint behavior, and anchor-observer failures retain their declared fixture scopes. It establishes no contact-bearing articulated limb, per-foot or per-contact load allocation, standing, bracing, fall arrest, getting up, gait, walking, accepted knowledge, or automatic creature guidance.

program.claim_scope: The declared single-link passive pendulum matches its analytic period, energy, sign, and damping controls within the measured fixture tolerances.

failure_boundaries: The parent is a fixed scaffold, not a free creature or support mechanism

mechanism: A live motor-disabled and limit-disabled HingeJoint3D constrains a rectangular link to one rotational degree of freedom. Its observed period is compared with an independent physical-pendulum inertia oracle, while energy and amplitude controls distinguish passive numerical behavior from declared damping.
